title: Tensor formulas for rational scalar fibre comparisons
statement: For any finite coefficient inclusion E into L and embeddings into a common field K, the existing rational scalar comparison, interpreted on the actual rational fibre functors, sends a tensor b tensor x to (a*j(b)) tensor (1 tensor the integral scalar unit of x), with all prescribed fibre object transports. For K=L, removing identity scalar extension gives the rational scalar isomorphism and exactly the required nested pure-tensor formula. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-integral-fibre-scalar-comparison], [lem-pod-lisse-rational-scalar-fiber-comparison], [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: The uniqueness isomorphisms between scalar-extension adjunctions preserve their units. Apply their unit identities to the successive ring, tensor and composite scalar functors in the existing rational comparison. This computes its value on the unit tensor.

Use linearity and the balanced tensor relation to obtain arbitrary nested pure tensors in a common coefficient field. Conjugate by the rational object equalities. At K=L compose with the identity scalar-extension isomorphism and replace the integral unit by its ring-extension pure-tensor formula.

theorem rationalFibreScalarIso_tensor (F : LisseRationalSheaf l E Y) (a : L) (b : E)
    (x : (lisseIntegralFiberFunctor l E Y y).obj F.integral) :
    eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l L Y y
      ((lisseRationalScalarExtension l E Y L ι).obj F))
      ((rationalFibreScalarIso l Y y E L ι ha).hom.app F
        (a ⊗ₜ[E,algebraMap E L]
          (eqToHom (lisseRationalFiberFunctor_obj l E Y y F).symm
            (b ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E] x)))) =
      (a * ι b) ⊗ₜ[Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l L]
        ((integralFibreScalarIso l Y y E L ι).hom.app F.integral
          (ModuleCat.ringExtensionTmul.{u + 1, u + 1}
            (lisseIntegerInclusion l E L ι) _ 1 x))
